_label: CHICAGO APPLICATION-CLAIMS DRAFT — authored from the existing sourced evidence; development only; practitioner review required
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Evidence, mythology, symbols, source history, conflicts and trace-only factors remain internal.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Emotional well-being may be rooted in the person's private inner foundation: home, belonging and the people who make them feel supported.
Internal contentment may depend on having somewhere the person can emotionally settle, not merely a physical home but a place where they feel safe enough to be themselves.
Family, chosen family or another dependable support system may form an important part of the person's emotional landscape.

The relationship with the mother or primary maternal figure may significantly shape how the person understands comfort, care and emotional security; the chart does not determine whether that relationship was easy or difficult.

prohibitedExtensions: claims about the person's actual childhood or family history
claim that the maternal relationship was good, bad, present, absent, nurturing or harmful without separate evidence
blaming the mother or maternal figure

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Friendship and supportive companionship may contribute to emotional ease.
Pleasant or aesthetically satisfying surroundings may contribute to emotional comfort.

traceOnlyEvidence: The source mentions endurance during long travel, but that topic is not necessary for this Section 2 reading.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Purva Bhadrapada is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The emotional life may be capable of holding opposing feelings, ideas or truths without reducing them immediately to a simple answer.
Ideals and inner commitments may be experienced with intensity rather than casually.
The mind may approach emotionally complex questions with cleverness and mental resourcefulness.
Emotional experience may sometimes carry periods of worry, sorrow or unusual heaviness.

compositionRequirements: APP-PB-EMOTIONAL-WEIGHT may appear only with APP-PB-MENTAL-RESOURCEFULNESS or another constructive admitted claim in the same paragraph.
APP-PB-PARADOX and APP-PB-IDEAL-INTENSITY require at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
prohibitedExtensions: claim that spiritual intensity is inherently superior

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Purva Bhadrapada's intensity may take a more initiating and immediate mode of expression in this pada.
Deeply held convictions may create a desire to act directly rather than remain only inwardly held.
The person may be willing to challenge established patterns when those patterns conflict with a deeply held conviction.
The combined pattern may create tension between remaining with complexity and acting decisively on conviction.
Development may involve allowing conviction to become clear before directing its intensity into purposeful action.

chartFacts: No graha drishti reaches the Moon.
Mars does not aspect the Moon and must never be described as doing so.
traceOnlyDirective.rule: These factors remain in the internal trace and do not enter customer prose until separate application records license a useful personal interpretation.

implementationRequirements: Preserve each claim's purposes field and route dynamically by purpose rather than hard-coding Chicago claim IDs.
When a nakshatra first appears, define it briefly in plain language and explain that it refines how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed before interpreting the named nakshatra.
Introduce the pada only after the nakshatra has been defined and interpreted.
Support both requires and requiresAny claim conditions.
Contract any paragraph whose routed claims cannot support its minimum word budget.
Do not pad the reading with source history, mythology, symbols, technical placements or trace-only factors.
Run the general acceptance suite; do not run the Lisbon-specific acceptance suite as the Chicago gate.
Production must continue returning zero customer claims because every record in this overlay is productionEligible false.
